requirements_summary: Workloads: nightly batch embeddings (500k-1M docs), near-real-time per-user embed on search queries (~200 req/s peak), semantic reranking for top-50 candidates.
Latency target: p50 < 50ms (embed endpoints), p99 retrieval path < 200ms end-to-end.
Throughput target: batch indexing >= 50k docs/hour on off-hours nodes; online embed burst capacity 200 req/s.
Vector DB: primary integration with Milvus (GCP), possibility to test Pinecone in later phase.
Model preferences: open-weights recommended; quantized variants OK; fallbacks for lower-cost model when Dedicated capacity constrained.
Operational: telemetry per-route, token-level cost breakdowns, alerts on embedding quality regressions, canary rollout for new model versions.
Compliance: data residency (US + EU considerations for some customers), retention policy configurable, need audit logs for 90 days.
